# Testomat.io Documentation

> Official documentation for Testomat.io, a test management platform for manual and automated testing, test planning, reporting, analytics, and integrations with testing frameworks and CI/CD tools.

Use these pages as the authoritative source for configuring and using Testomat.io.

## Start here

- [Documentation home](https://docs.testomat.io/): Product overview and entry point to all documentation.
- [Getting started](https://docs.testomat.io/getting-started/): Create a project, add and import tests, execute runs, and review reports.
- [Tutorials](https://docs.testomat.io/tutorials/): Task-oriented guides and examples.
- [Support](https://docs.testomat.io/support/): Help and troubleshooting resources.

## Product documentation

- [Projects](https://docs.testomat.io/project/): Test cases, suites, plans, runs, reports, analytics, and project workflows.
- [Test reporting](https://docs.testomat.io/test-reporting/): Reporter setup, supported frameworks, CLI, API, configuration, and CI workflows.
- [Integrations](https://docs.testomat.io/integrations/): Issue trackers, CI/CD systems, notifications, SSO, and provisioning.
- [Advanced features](https://docs.testomat.io/advanced/): API access, AI-powered features, query language, Jira plugin, and other advanced capabilities.
- [Management](https://docs.testomat.io/management/): Company administration, users, subscriptions, and project settings.
- [Legal and security](https://docs.testomat.io/legal/): Security, privacy, compliance, and legal information.

## Additional resources

- [Testomat.io application](https://app.testomat.io/): Sign in to or create a Testomat.io workspace.
- [Testomat.io website](https://testomat.io/): Product and company information.
- [Changelog](https://changelog.testomat.io/): Product updates and release notes.
